umanresaPage.heroSubtitle: Central Manresa apartment for university visits, training and short stays.

sections.title: Who it is useful for
paragraphs: Parents visiting students, lecturers, conferences, training courses and short stays linked to UManresa, FUB or other faculties in the university area.

sections.title: Location relative to the university
paragraphs: QEhome is in central Manresa, not on campus. From here you reach the university area on foot or with short trips across the city.
The FGC station is a few minutes away. Useful if you combine university, the historic centre and travel around Catalonia.

umanresaPage.apartmentText: Same address, same facts: holiday apartment in central Manresa with parking and self check-in.

queVerPage.heroSubtitle: Local guide for 1 or 2 days: historic centre, essentials and day trips to Montserrat and Pla de Bages.

sections.title: Manresa in one day
paragraphs: Start with the historic centre and the Seu (Basilica of Santa Maria). Head down to the Cardener and the Cave of Saint Ignatius if you are interested in Ignatian heritage.
The old town is walkable. With parking in the building you do not depend on street parking to move around the centre.
items: Walk through the centre and shops
Viewpoints and the Cardener river area

sections.title: If you have two days
paragraphs: Day two fits a day trip well: Montserrat is about 30 minutes by car, and Pla de Bages opens landscape and winery routes.
Manresa works as a base: sleep in the centre, go out by day and come back without depending on hotel hours.

sections.title: Practical details
items: FGC a few minutes away for Barcelona
Full kitchen if you want to eat in the apartment

caminoPage.h1: Accommodation in Manresa for the Ignatian Way
caminoPage.heroSubtitle: Central apartment for pilgrims and travellers on the Ignatian Way who finish or stay overnight in Manresa.

sections.title: Manresa on the Ignatian Way
paragraphs: Manresa is a key point on the Ignatian Way, linked to Saint Ignatius's stay and the Cave of Saint Ignatius.
Whether you arrive on foot, by transport or by combining stages, the centre puts you near Ignatian sites and everyday services.

sections.title: Why an apartment fits
paragraphs: Self check-in: useful if you arrive outside reception hours. Full kitchen if you want a rest day or to cook. Two bedrooms if you travel as a couple or a small group.
items: Parking in the building if you arrive by car

sections.title: After Manresa
paragraphs: From here you can also connect to Montserrat, Barcelona by FGC or continue routes around Bages without changing base.

caminoPage.apartmentText: QEhome is in central Manresa. Same facts as on the home page: parking, self check-in and a strong Booking score.

montserratPage.heroSubtitle: Montserrat about 30 minutes away. Manresa as your base: centre, parking and train to Barcelona.

sections.title: Manresa as a base, not a «hotel at Montserrat»
paragraphs: QEhome is in Manresa, not in Monistrol or on the mountain. The idea is to sleep in central Manresa and visit Montserrat for the day.
By car, Montserrat is about 30 minutes away. You can also combine the visit with Manresa's old town on the same trip.

sections.title: How to plan the visit
items: Monastery, reservoirs and walks depending on time
Return to Manresa in the afternoon
Dinner in the centre or in the apartment

sections.title: Why sleeping in Manresa helps
paragraphs: Parking in the building if you drive. Self check-in. Two bedrooms. FGC nearby if you also want Barcelona another day.

enoturismoPage.h1: Wine tourism in Pla de Bages from Manresa
enoturismoPage.heroSubtitle: Wineries and landscape about 30 minutes away. Sleep in central Manresa and drive out to the wine route.

sections.title: Pla de Bages from the city
paragraphs: Pla de Bages concentrates wineries, farmland and wine experiences a short distance from Manresa.
QEhome is not a rural house among vineyards. It is an urban apartment with parking: go out to wineries by day and return to the centre.

sections.title: How a weekend fits
items: Arrive in Manresa and self check-in
One day of wineries and landscape in Pla de Bages
Another day for central Manresa or Montserrat
Full kitchen if you want breakfast or dinner in the apartment

sections.title: What QEhome adds to this route
paragraphs: Private parking in the building. Electric car charger if you drive an EV. 9.7 on Booking. Central location to combine wine, city and train.
